parsed.rationale: Both `HSBColor.uiColor` and `HSBColor.nsColor` are computed properties in the same file (`Shared/ColorPalette/Sources/ColorPalette/HSBColor.swift`) that convert an `HSBColor` value to platform-specific color types — `UIColor` (UIKit/iOS) and `NSColor` (AppKit/macOS) respectively. Their structural similarity (Jaccard 0.71) reflects the parallel conversion pattern, but they are intentionally distinct: each targets a different platform framework and cannot be unified without introducing a conditional or type-erased wrapper that would obscure intent. No restraint markers are present, but the divergence is load-bearing platform specialization, not accidental duplication. Merging or abstracting them would add complexity with no real reduction in maintenance surface.
